items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 20:1
items.html: Its extension from below upward is called the Yesodot of AVI [Abba ve-Ima], which emerged through the coarseness of phase one, whose level reaches ZA. And from above downward, this level expanded into the reign of King Tifferet, down to his chest. It is the aspect of Ruach of ZA. (p. 522, Item 45)
